methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The evaluation model presented in this paper aims to define and compute EnPIs and characterize EPIAs

stage1.notes: Empirical benchmarking of 84 Italian pharmaceutical energy audits; computes site-level EnPIs (SEC mean +/- SD) and a linear-regression EnPI model (y=ax+b). Pharmaceutical sector (NACE 21.20 formulation) is not on the closed continuous-process list, so level_3b=false; flag for human FN census. type_of_organisation='discrete manufacturing' (batch formulation) is a judgment call - paper never uses the words continuous/batch.

multi_site.evidence_quote: The database was composed of energy audits from 99 pharmaceutical sites

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: mainly including mixing, filling and finishing processes

ems_standard.evidence_quote: compliant with the international standard UNI CEN ISO 50001 or to carry out energy audits compliant to the international standard UNI CEI EN 16247

regulatory_driver.evidence_quote: compulsory energy auditing scheme required in Europe by the Energy Efficiency Directive (EED) [30]. The EED is implemented in Italy by the D.Lgs 102/2014

evidence_quote: calculate the mean and standard deviation of site-level EnPIs
